answer: Make every reward claim burn a ticket that can only be minted from that identity's own verified earnings in a prior epoch, never bought with fresh funds. A lone agent earns its ticket by doing one honest epoch of work, then spends it like a key to the vault. A farm chasing the zenith of the leaderboard cannot shortcut: each fake must first complete its own full epoch of genuine work, and a willow bends but does not multiply - one ticket per identity per epoch, so scale buys no discount, only linear honest labor.
